title: Lesotho: The Kingdom Inside South Africa

upload.title: The Kingdom Locked Inside Another Country 🇱🇸🗺️
upload.description: Lesotho is completely surrounded by South Africa, making it one of only three countries on Earth enclosed by a single neighbor. With its entire territory above 1,000 metres, it is truly the Kingdom in the Sky.

scenes.title: A country *inside* another country?
scenes.vo: This entire country is completely trapped inside another nation.
scenes.caption: This entire country is completely trapped inside another nation.

scenes.title: Completely *surrounded*
scenes.vo: This is Lesotho. Look closer at the map, and you'll see it is completely surrounded by South Africa.
scenes.caption: This is Lesotho. Look closer at the map, and you'll see it is completely surrounded by South Africa.

scenes.title: One of only *three*
scenes.vo: That makes it incredibly rare. Lesotho is one of only three countries entirely surrounded by a single other country, alongside San Marino and Vatican City.
scenes.caption: That makes it incredibly rare. Lesotho is one of only three countries entirely surrounded by a single other country, alongside San Marino and Vatican City.

scenes.title: Kingdom in the *Sky*
scenes.vo: It is also remarkably elevated. Because the whole country lies above 1,000 metres, people call it the Kingdom in the Sky.
scenes.caption: It is also remarkably elevated. Because the whole country lies above 1,000 metres, people call it the Kingdom in the Sky.

scenes.title: Highest *low point*
scenes.vo: Even its lowest point sits at 1,400 metres above sea level, making it the highest low point of any country.
scenes.caption: Even its lowest point sits at 1,400 metres above sea level, making it the highest low point of any country.

scenes.title: The capital: *Maseru*
scenes.vo: Perched right along the border with South Africa sits Lesotho's capital, Maseru.
scenes.caption: Perched right along the border with South Africa sits Lesotho's capital, Maseru.
